purpose: 1 minute candles around scheduled prints for the next-meeting Fed decision market and up to four slower macro markets; time exit test
auth: none (public market data; no key, no header, no cookie)
on_429: wait 300 seconds and resume; stop the job for good at 5 refusals; never loop
writes: only the output folder on a data branch; never main; no Firestore; nothing under functions/

stage_1_calendar.output: print_days.csv (series, event, close_time = print time T)
stage_1_calendar.check: Aug to Dec 2026 rows must equal kalshi-scalper/studies/EVENT_CALENDAR_2026.csv on V2's branch to the minute; mismatches are dropped and listed

stage_2_candles.for_each: print day in the FIRST TWO THIRDS of print days only
stage_2_candles.markets: F = KXFEDDECISION next meeting, highest YES mid at T-5; S1, S2 = the two later meetings; S3 = the rate cut count series for the year (name confirmed in stage 1); S4 = KXFED last meeting of the year; in each slow series the one market nearest 50c at T-5
stage_2_candles.extra: daily candles (period_interval 1440) for the 60 trading days before each print for the betas: about 20 requests

heldout_rule: the last third of print days gets NO candle request until the development result is committed
